# Keep a delivery checklist alongside your purchase

Plan how you will preserve access to the material you purchase before relying on it for a project.

## Record the delivery terms

Check how the package is delivered, whether download links expire, what updates are included, and how to contact support. Keep those details with the product version and purchase confirmation.

## Preserve the archive

Download through the documented process and keep an untouched copy in a location you control. Record a checksum if you use checksums in your normal workflow. A checksum helps detect a change to a file; by itself, it does not prove who authored it.

## Confirm the contents

Compare the archive against the delivery inventory. Check that documentation, source, assets, and any promised configuration examples are present. Track missing items before beginning substantial customization.

## Keep access separate

Use your own service and developer accounts for your product. Record required account setup steps without storing passwords or tokens in project documentation. Review the actual package terms for the uses you intend.
